BIB.INSTANCE.TITLE: Regulation (EU) 2024/1069 of the European Parliament and of the Council on construction products

PREAMBLE.RECITAL: Whereas construction products play a critical role in building safety and energy performance.
Whereas circular economy and decarbonisation of cement and steel are necessary.

PARAGRAPH.ALINEA: This Regulation lays down rules for making available on the market and direct installation of construction products.
'construction product' means any formed or formless physical item in sectors C23 and C24.
Manufacturers in sector C24 shall establish a digital construction passport for steel products by 2026-01-01.
Installations with annual production below 500 tonnes shall be exempt from the requirement in paragraph 1.
Producers in sector C23 shall report environmental product declarations for cement and concrete. No numeric limit is specified.
Regulation (EU) 2020/852 is amended as follows: in Article 10, paragraph 3 is replaced.
